purpose: Minimum prerequisite transverse contracts required before GATE21 precontract. These are thin contracts/invariants, not Gates, not a GEE revision, and not a new control plane.

rules: New GATE21 artifacts MUST resolve through these roots or explicit test fixtures.
No new hard-coded machine-home paths such as C:\Users\melan\...
Existing constitution canonicalPath remains MACHINE_SPECIFIC and is not amended by GATE21.
Classify artifacts as PORTABLE_PERSISTENT, RECONSTRUCTIBLE, or MACHINE_SPECIFIC.
Full EXPORT → COPY/MOVE → RESTORE → REBIND → INTEGRITY CHECK → SMOKE TEST remains GATE40, not GATE21 implementation.
GATE21 must prove a relocated DATA_ROOT still replays the same snapshot digest.

FREE_DATA_SOURCE_POLICY.default: ALL NEW FUTURE DATA REQUIRED BY WHEEL/JARVISE MUST BE FREE BY DEFAULT.
ifNoReliableFreeSource: omit from required V1, or mark UNAVAILABLE / OPTIONAL_FUTURE / DEGRADED
do not introduce a paid dependency
FREE_DATA_SOURCE_POLICY.ibkrTwsExistingPath: KEEP as MACHINE_SPECIFIC existing read-only path; not a required GATE21 source; not a new paid API.

rules: Declare one workspace, one manifest, delete one exact path.
No glob or broad-delete of unknown Temp data.
Never delete unknown dirty human work.
Fail safely on locked/active files; report cleanup failures.
Cleanup must not alter canonical history and should be idempotent where practical.
GATE21 does not clean historical leftover directories such as d03-hostile-* or gate-start-future-*.
